heading: Art. 1.
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
1. gr. 2. гр

Hafi refsilöggjöf breyst frá því að verknaður var framinn til þess er dómur gengur, skal dæma eftir nýrri lögunum, bæði um refsinæmi verknaðar og refsingu. Aldrei má þó dæma refsingu, nema heimild hafi verið til þess í lögum, þegar verk var framið, og ekki þyngri refsingu en orðið hefði eftir þeim lögum. Hafi refsiákvæði laga fallið úr gildi af ástæðum, sem ekki bera vitni um breytt mat löggjafans á refsinæmi verknaðar, skal dæma eftir lögum þeim, sem í gildi voru, þegar brot var framið.

Falli refsinæmi verknaðar niður af öðrum ástæðum en síðast var getið, fellur refsing niður, sem dæmd hefur verið fyrir þann verknað, að því leyti, sem hún hefur þá ekki þegar verið framkvæmd. Einnig falla þá niður aðrar afleiðingar verknaðar, sem refsinæmi hans að eldri lögum leiddi af sér, að undantekinni skyldu til greiðslu sakarkostnaðar. Bera má þá undir dómstól þann, sem dæmdi í því máli í héraði, eða dómstól á heimavarnarþingi aðilja, hvort refsing samkvæmt dóminum skuli niður falla eða lækka, ef dómurinn tekur jafnframt til fleiri brota. Niðurstöðu héraðsdóms má áfrýja.

[2. гр. а.

Viðurlögum þeim við brotum, sem um getur í VII. kafla laga þessara, verður ekki beitt, nema um þau hafi verið mælt í heimildum þeim, er greinir í 1. gr., á þeim tíma, er brot var framið, og skal gæta meginreglna 2.
translated_text:
Art. 1.

No person shall be punished unless he has committed conduct for which punishment is prescribed by law, or which can be entirely equated with conduct which is considered an offence therein.

[Sanctions pursuant to Chapter VII of this Act may not be applied unless they are provided for in the provisions referred to in para. 1.] 1)

1) Act 31/1961.

translated_text:
Art. 2.

If penal legislation has changed from the time an act was committed until judgment is rendered, judgment shall be made according to the new law, both regarding the punishability of the act and the punishment. However, punishment may never be imposed unless there was authority for it in law when the act was committed, and not a more severe punishment than would have been imposed under that law. If a penal provision of law has been repealed for reasons that do not indicate a changed assessment by the legislature of the punishability of the act, judgment shall be made according to the law that was in force when the offence was committed.

If the punishability of an act ceases for reasons other than those last mentioned, the punishment that has been imposed for that act shall lapse, to the extent that it has not already been executed. Also lapse then are other consequences of the act that its punishability under the former law entailed, with the exception of the obligation to pay legal costs. It may then be brought before the court that judged the case in the district court, or a court at the parties' domicile jurisdiction, whether the punishment according to the judgment shall lapse or be reduced, if the judgment also covers several offences. The decision of a district court may be appealed.

[Art. 2 a.

The sanctions for offences referred to in Chapter VII of this Act may not be applied unless they were provided for in the provisions referred to in Art. 1, at the time the offence was committed, and the main rules of Art. 2 shall be observed when determining them.] 1)

1) Act 31/1961.

heading: 2. gr. 3. gr.

text:
2. gr. 3. гр

Þegar refsilöggjöfin lætur ítrekun brots varða aukinni refsingu eða öðrum viðurlögum, skal refsiákvörðun samkvæmt eldri lögum hafa ítrekunaráhrif eftir orðan sinni, eins og hún hefði verið gerð eftir nýrri lögunum.

4. гр.

Refsað skal eftir íslenskum hegningarlögum:

1. Fyrir brot, framin innan íslenska ríkisins. Sé brot framið af starfsmanni eða farþega erlends skips eða loftfars, sem hér er á ferð, gegn manni, sem með farinu fylgist, eða hagsmunum, sem við farið eru nátengdir, skal þó því aðeins refsa hér, að [ráðherra] 1) fyrirskipi rannsókn og málshöfðun.

2. Fyrir brot, framin á íslenskum skipum eða í íslenskum loftförum, hvar sem þau hafa þá verið stödd. Hafi brot verið framið á stað, þar sem refsivald annars ríkis nær til að þjóðarétti, og af manni, sem hvorki var fastur starfsmaður né farþegi á farinu, skal þó ekki refsað hér, nema heimild sé til þess eftir 5. eða 6. gr.

[3. Fyrir brot gegn 264. gr., framið innan íslenska ríkisins enda þótt frumbrotið sem ávinningur stafar frá hafi verið framið erlendis og án tillits til hver var að því valdur.] 2)
translated_text:
2. gr. 3. gr.

When criminal legislation provides that repetition of an offense shall result in increased punishment or other sanctions, a penal decision under the former law shall have the effect of repetition according to its wording, as if it had been made under the new law.

4. gr.

Punishment shall be imposed under Icelandic criminal law:

1. For offenses committed within the Icelandic state. If an offense is committed by a crew member or passenger of a foreign ship or aircraft which is traveling here, against a person who is traveling with the vessel, or interests which are closely connected with the vessel, punishment shall, however, only be imposed here if [the minister] 1) orders investigation and prosecution.

2. For offenses committed on Icelandic ships or in Icelandic aircraft, wherever they may have been located at the time. If an offense has been committed in a place where the penal jurisdiction of another state extends under international law, and by a person who was neither a permanent crew member nor a passenger on the vessel, punishment shall, however, not be imposed here unless there is authority to do so under Art. 5 or 6.

[3. For offenses against Art. 264, committed within the Icelandic state even though the primary offense from which the proceeds derive was committed abroad and regardless of who was responsible for it.] 2)

text:
5. gr

Fyrir verknað, sem íslenskir ríkisborgarar eða menn, búsettir á Íslandi, hafa framið erlendis, skal refsað eftir íslenskum hegningarlögum:

1. Ef brot er framið á stað, sem refsivald annarra ríkja nær ekki til að þjóðarétti, og var þá jafnframt refsivert eftir lögum heimaríkis sakbornings.

2. Ef brot er framið á stað, sem refsivald annars ríkis nær til að þjóðarétti, og var þá jafnframt refsivert eftir lögum þess.

[Ákvæði 1. mgr. má beita um verknað manns, sem er ríkisborgari í eða búsettur í Danmörku, Finnlandi, Noregi eða Svíþjóð og dvelst hér á landi.] 1)

[Í þeim tilvikum sem greinir í 2. tölul. 1. mgr. skal refsað eftir íslenskum hegningarlögum fyrir brot manns, sem var íslenskur ríkisborgari eða búsettur hér á landi á verknaðarstundu, er fellur undir [194. gr., 2.–4. mgr. 206. gr., 1. mgr. 210. gr. b, 2. mgr. 216. gr., 218. gr. a, 2. mgr. 225. gr.] 2) og 2. tölul. 1. mgr. 227. gr. a og framið er erlendis þrátt fyrir að verknaðurinn teljist ekki refsiverður eftir lögum þess ríkis. Sama gildir um brot manns gegn barni yngra en 15 ára er fellur undir … 2) 197.–198. gr. … 2) og 1. mgr. 202. gr., svo og brot manns er fellur undir 1. mgr. 210. gr. a, enda sé um að ræða framleiðslu efnis sem þar greinir. [Sama gildir um brot sem falla undir lög um refsingar fyrir hópmorð, glæpi gegn mannúð, stríðsglæpi og glæpi gegn friði.] 3) 4) 1) L. 101/1976, 2.

5. gr.

For acts which Icelandic citizens or persons resident in Iceland have committed abroad, punishment shall be imposed under Icelandic criminal law:

1. If the offense is committed in a place to which the penal jurisdiction of other states does not extend under international law, and was at the same time punishable under the law of the home state of the accused.

2. If the offense is committed in a place to which the penal jurisdiction of another state extends under international law, and was at the same time punishable under the law of that state.

[The provision of para. 1 may be applied to acts of a person who is a citizen of or resident in Denmark, Finland, Norway or Sweden and is staying in this country.] 1)

[In the cases referred to in no. 2 of para. 1, punishment shall be imposed under Icelandic criminal law for offenses by a person who was an Icelandic citizen or resident here at the time of the act, which fall under [Art. 194, paras. 2–4 of Art. 206, para. 1 of Art. 210 b, para. 2 of Art. 216, Art. 218 a, para. 2 of Art. 225] 2) and no. 2 of para. 1 of Art. 227 a and committed abroad even though the act is not considered punishable under the law of that state. The same applies to offenses by a person against a child younger than 15 years which fall under … 2) Arts. 197–198 … 2) and para. 1 of Art. 202, as well as offenses by a person which fall under para. 1 of Art. 210 a, provided that it concerns production of material as described therein. [The same applies to offenses which fall under the Act on Punishment for Genocide, Crimes Against Humanity, War Crimes and Crimes Against Peace.] 3) 4) 1) Act 101/1976, Art. 2.

gr. 6. gr

Ennfremur skal refsað eftir íslenskum hegningarlögum fyrir brot, sem þannig er háttað, er hér á eftir segir, enda þótt það sé framið utan íslenska ríkisins og án tillits til þess, hver er að því valdur:

1. Gegn sjálfstæði íslenska ríkisins, öryggi þess, stjórnskipan og stjórnvöldum, á embættis- eða sýslunarskyldum við íslenska ríkið og gegn hagsmunum, sem njóta íslenskrar réttarverndar, vegna náins sambands við íslenska ríkið.

2. Á skyldum, sem þeim, er verkið vann, bar samkvæmt íslenskum lögum að rækja erlendis, svo og á skyldum samkvæmt ráðningu á íslenskt far.

translated_text:
Chapter II. General conditions for punishment.

Article 12

An act is not punishable which persons perform in self-defence, to the extent that it has been necessary to defend against or avert an unlawful attack which has begun or is imminent, provided that defence has not been used which is manifestly more dangerous than the attack and the damage which could be expected from it gave cause for.

If a person has exceeded the limits of lawful self-defence, and the reason for this is that he has become so frightened or confused that he could not fully control himself, he shall not be punished.

heading: Article 13
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
Article 13

An act is not punishable which necessity required to be performed for the purpose of protecting lawful interests against imminent danger, even though other interests are thereby impaired which must be considered to be of much lesser importance.

heading: Article 14
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
Article 14

A person shall not be punished for an act which he committed before he reached the age of 15 years.

heading: Article 15
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
Article 15

Persons shall not be punished who, due to mental illness, mental underdevelopment or deterioration, impairment of consciousness or other comparable condition, were completely incapable at the time they performed the act of controlling their actions.

heading: Article 16
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
Article 16

If the person who performed the act was mentally below par, such as due to underdevelopment, deterioration, sexual maldevelopment or other disturbance, but this condition of his is not at as high a level as Article 15 provides, he shall then be punished for the offence if it may be expected according to circumstances and after medical opinion has been sought that punishment can be effective.

If an institution is established for such persons as this Article provides for, it may be determined in a criminal judgment that the convicted person shall serve [his sentence] 1) in the institution.

translated_text:
Article 17

Punishment shall be applied even though an offence has been committed in intoxication or under the influence of other intoxicants. If there has been complete impairment of consciousness, however, punishment shall not be imposed unless the accused had known in advance or had complete reason to expect that he would commit the offence while under the influence, or that it would result from this condition of his.

heading: Article 18

translated_text:
Article 18

An act for which punishment is imposed in this Act is not culpable unless it is performed intentionally or negligently. Negligent offences shall only be punished if there is specific authorization for this in the law.

text:
gr. III

kafli. Tilraun og hlutdeild.
translated_text:
Chapter III. Attempt and complicity.

Article 20

Every person who has made a decision to perform an act for which punishment is imposed in this Act, and has unequivocally shown that intention in an act which is directed at or is intended to be directed at the execution of the offence, has, when the offence is not completed, become guilty of an attempt to commit it.

For an attempt to commit an offence, a lower punishment may be imposed than is prescribed for a completed offence. This shall especially be done when it may be inferred from the attempt that the offender is not as dangerous and his will not as hardened as may be expected to be the case with persons who complete such offences.

If the interests which the act is directed at, or the act itself, are such that the attempt could not have led to a completed offence, it may be determined that punishment shall lapse.

heading: Article 21
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
Article 21

Punishment for an attempt lapses if the person who has become guilty of it voluntarily abandons his intention to commit the offence before it is completed, provided that its execution does not fail or the intended result is not achieved due to obstacles or other chance, and he has furthermore, if he has by his act caused or believed himself to have caused a risk that the offence would be completed, prevented it or taken such measures as would have prevented it if the completion of the offence had not, without his knowledge, been averted in another way or been unexecutable.

translated_text:
22. gr

Every person who, by assistance in word or deed, persuasion, incitement or in any other way, takes part in the commission of an offence under this Act, shall be subject to the punishment prescribed for the offence.

If the participation of any participant in the offence is minor, or consists in strengthening the intention of another person which has already been formed, and also when an offence is not completed or intended participation has failed, he may be sentenced to a lighter punishment than that prescribed for the offence.

When the circumstances are as stated in the second paragraph, and likewise if a person has through negligence come to take part in an offence, the punishment may be waived if the offence falls under a penal provision where no heavier punishment is prescribed than [imprisonment up to 1 year]. 1)

When an offence is completed, a person who provides assistance to the offender himself or to others in order to maintain the unlawful state which has been created by the offence, or benefits from it, shall be subject to punishment according to the provisions of this Article, provided that other provisions of law do not apply to his conduct.

Þegar svo stendur á, má ekki dæma í vægari refsingu en [fangelsi]. ²) … ²)

Ákvæðum fyrsta málsliðs undanfarandi málsgreinar má einnig beita, þegar brot, sem þar er nefnt, er framið af fyrrverandi refsifanga gegn yfirmönnum eða starfsmönnum hegningarhúss þess, sem hann átti dvöl í, eða brotið beinist að hegningarhúsinu eða eignum þess, svo og ef fyrrverandi refsifangi gerist sekur um brot á ákvæðum 111. gr., að því er varðar fanga, sem taka út refsingu í hegningarhúsi því, er hann dvaldist áður í.

Ef maður, sem dæmdur hefur verið til ævilangrar fangelsisvistar og ekki hefur verið náðaður, fremur nýtt brot í fangelsinu eða utan þess, skal ákveða í dómi, hvaða refsingu hann ætti að sæta, ef fyrri refsingin hefði ekki verið ævilangt fangelsi. text:
14. gr. 74. gr

Refsingu þá, sem í lögum er lögð við broti, má færa niður úr lágmarki því, sem þar er ákveðið, þegar svo stendur á, sem hér á eftir segir:

1. Þegar maður hefur farið út fyrir takmörk leyfilegrar neyðarvarnar eða neyðarréttar.

2. Þegar brot er drýgt af manni, sem þá er ekki fullra 18 ára að aldri, og álíta má vegna æsku hans, að full refsing sé ónauðsynleg eða skaðleg. Aldrei má dæma í þyngri hegningu fyrir brot, sem menn hafa framið á þessum aldri, en 8 ára fangelsi.

3. Hafi sá, sem verkið vann, álitið, að verknaður hans væri ekki réttarbrot, sökum afsakanlegrar vanþekkingar eða misskilnings á réttarreglum sem banna framkvæmd verknaðar.

4. Þegar maður hefur framið brot í mikilli reiði eða geðæsingu, sem sá, er fyrir brotinu verður, hefur vakið hjá honum með ólögmætri árás eða stórfelldri móðgun.

5. Ef maður lætur leiðast til að fremja brot sökum þess, að hann var öðrum háður.

6. Ef maður er beittur þvingun til að fremja brot, en þvinguninni er þó ekki þannig varið, að hún geri verknað hans að öllu leyti refsilausan.

7. Ef sá, sem verk vann, hefur af sjálfsdáðum, eftir að það var fullframið, afstýrt hættu þeirri, sem það hafði í för með sér.

8. Ef sá, sem verkið vann, hefur af sjálfsdáðum bætt að fullu tjón það, sem af verkinu leiddi, svo og þegar hann hefur gert sér mikið far um að koma í veg fyrir skaðlegar afleiðingar verksins eða reynt eftir mætti að bæta úr tjóninu.

9. Ef maður segir af sjálfsdáðum til brots síns og skýrir hreinskilningslega frá öllum atvikum að því [eða veitir af sjálfsdáðum aðstoð eða upplýsingar sem hafa verulega þýðingu við að upplýsa brot hans, aðild annarra að brotinu eða önnur brot]. ¹)

Ákveða má, þegar svo stendur á, sem í 1.–8. tölul. segir, að refsing skuli falla niður að öllu leyti.

¹) L. 47/2015.

2. gr. 56. gr

[When a party has confessed to an offence, the [prosecutor] 1) is authorized to postpone prosecution for punishment for a specified period of time, as follows:

1. For offences committed by young persons aged 15–21 years.

2. When the circumstances of the accused are such that supervision or other measures pursuant to paragraph 3 of Article 57 may be considered more likely to succeed than punishment, provided that the offence is not of such a nature that public interest requires prosecution. The probationary period may not be shorter than 1 year and not longer than 5 years. As a rule, it shall be set at 2–3 years.

The [prosecutor] 1) determines in each case the commencement date of the postponement.

When prosecution is postponed, conditions may be imposed on the party as listed in paragraph 3 of Article 57, as deemed appropriate. Conditions may be modified during the probationary period, including extending the postponement, but not beyond 5 years in total.

[A party's case may be reopened if an investigation is commenced by the police against him as an accused before the probationary period expires for a new offence committed by him during the probationary period or before the case was postponed, and also if he otherwise breaches in material respects the conditions imposed on him.] 2)

When the [investigator] 3) considers that prosecution may be postponed pursuant to this Article, he shall submit the case to the [prosecutor] 1) and send him his proposals.

When a complaint is postponed pursuant to the provisions of this Article, the [prosecutor] 1) shall thoroughly inform the party of the conditions and make clear to him the consequences of breach of probation.] 4)

heading: 57. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
57. gr

[It may be determined in a judgment that the following shall be postponed with conditions for a specified period of time:

a. Determination of punishment.

b. Execution of punishment.

The probationary period may not be shorter than 1 year and not longer than 5 years. As a rule, it shall be set at 2–3 years. The commencement of the probationary period shall be determined in each judgment.

Postponement shall be subject to the condition that the party does not become guilty of a new offence during the probationary period, cf. Article 60. Postponement may also be subject to conditions as follows:

1. That the party shall be under the supervision of individuals, an association or an institution during the probationary period. The party shall normally be subject to such supervision if conditions are imposed on him pursuant to items 2–5 below.

2. That the party shall comply with the supervisor's instructions regarding place of residence, education, work, association with other persons and use of leisure time.

3. That the party shall not consume alcohol or narcotics during the probationary period.

4. That the party shall submit to residence at a facility for a specified period, if deemed necessary, up to 18 months, to wean him from the use of alcohol or narcotics, but otherwise up to 1 year.

5. That the party shall submit to restrictions on control over his income or other matters concerning his finances.

6. That the party shall pay, according to his ability, compensation for damage caused by his offence.

...

The judge shall thoroughly inform the convicted person of the conditions and make clear to him the consequences of breach of probation. [If the convicted person has not been present at the pronouncement of the district court judgment, the judge may instruct the police to inform him of the conditions and consequences of breach of probation at the time the judgment is served.] 2)] 3)

62. gr

heading: Article 66

translated_text:
Article 66

If any person threatens another person or threatens them with death, fire or other harm, and either punishment cannot be imposed or it is deemed not to provide sufficient security, the prosecution may intervene, upon the request of the person concerned, or without their request if deemed necessary for legal security, so that a court order is issued on whether measures should be taken to prevent the threat from being carried out, including whether the threatening person should provide security or whether they should be placed in custody. A court may revoke the measures if they are deemed no longer necessary due to changed circumstances.

If the prosecution so requests, the case may always be brought before a court for a new ruling. The convicted person may also always request, when 6 months have elapsed from the pronouncement of judgment or the last ruling, and earlier if the prosecution agrees, that the case be brought before a court for a new ruling at public instigation.

heading: 14. gr. 74. gr

translated_text:
14. gr. 74. gr

The penalty prescribed by law for an offence may be reduced below the minimum provided therein when circumstances are as follows:

1. When a person has exceeded the limits of lawful self-defence or necessity.

2. When an offence is committed by a person who is not yet 18 years of age, and it may be considered, due to his youth, that full punishment is unnecessary or harmful. No heavier penalty than 8 years' imprisonment may ever be imposed for an offence committed at this age.

3. If the person who committed the act believed that his act was not a criminal offence, due to excusable ignorance or misunderstanding of the legal rules prohibiting the commission of the act.

4. When a person has committed an offence in great anger or agitation which the victim of the offence has provoked in him by unlawful assault or grave insult.

5. If a person is induced to commit an offence because he was dependent on another.

6. If a person is subjected to coercion to commit an offence, but the coercion is not such as to make his act entirely exempt from punishment.

7. If the person who committed the act has, of his own accord, after it was completed, averted the danger which it entailed.

8. If the person who committed the act has, of his own accord, fully compensated the damage resulting from the act, as well as when he has made great efforts to prevent the harmful consequences of the act or tried to the best of his ability to remedy the damage.

9. If a person reports his offence of his own accord and gives a frank account of all circumstances relating to it [or provides of his own accord assistance or information of significant importance in clarifying his offence, the participation of others in the offence or other offences]. ¹)

It may be decided, when circumstances are as stated in items 1–8, that punishment shall be entirely waived.

Nú hefur fangi tekið út nokkurn hluta [fangelsis] 1) eða hælisvistar, en er veitt reynslulausn eða skilyrt náðun. Rjúfi hann síðan skilorð og ákvörðun er tekin um, að hann afpláni það, sem eftir stendur af [fangelsi] 1) eða hælisvist, og telst þá fyrning á fullnustu eftirstöðva refsingar og annarra dæmdra viðurlaga frá því, er slík ákvörðun var tekin. Ef fullnusta refsingar eða annarra viðurlaga samkvæmt 1. mgr. stöðvast af öðrum ástæðum en þeim, sem greinir í þessari málsgrein, telst fyrning frá því, að stöðvun varð.] 2)

heading: 86. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
86. gr

Hver, sem sekur gerist um verknað, sem miðar að því, að reynt verði með ofbeldi, hótun um ofbeldi, annarri nauðung eða svikum að ráða íslenska ríkið eða hluta þess undir erlend yfirráð, eða að ráða annars einhvern hluta ríkisins undan forræði þess, skal sæta fangelsi ekki skemur en 4 ár eða ævilangt.
translated_text:
86. gr

Anyone who becomes guilty of an act aimed at attempting by violence, threat of violence, other coercion or fraud to bring the Icelandic state or part thereof under foreign rule, or to remove any part of the state from its authority, shall be subject to imprisonment for not less than 4 years or for life.

heading: 87. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
87. gr

Geri maður samband við stjórn erlends ríkis til þess að stofna til fjandsamlegra tiltækja eða ófriðar við íslenska ríkið eða bandamenn þess, án þess að verknaðurinn varði við 86. gr., þá varðar það fangelsi ekki skemur en 2 ár eða ævilangt. Sé þetta í því skyni gert að koma erlendu ríki til þess að skerða sjálfsákvörðunarrétt íslenska ríkisins á annan hátt, þá varðar það fangelsi allt að 8 árum.
translated_text:
87. gr

If a person makes contact with the government of a foreign state in order to initiate hostile actions or war against the Icelandic state or its allies, without the act falling under Article 86, this is punishable by imprisonment for not less than 2 years or for life. If this is done with the purpose of causing a foreign state to curtail the right of self-determination of the Icelandic state in another way, this is punishable by imprisonment up to 8 years.

heading: 88. gr

text:

Ef brot þykir mjög smávægilegt, má beita sektarhegningu.] 2)

1) L. 82/1998, 21.

88. gr

[Anyone who publicly in speech or writing advocates or contributes to a foreign state beginning hostile actions against the Icelandic state or interfering in its affairs, as well as anyone who causes a risk of such interference by insults, physical assaults, property damage and other actions likely to cause such risk, shall be subject to … 1) imprisonment up to 6 years. If the offence is considered very minor, a fine may be imposed.] 2)

1) L. 82/1998, 21.

Sömu refsingu skal hver sá sæta, sem í ófriði, eða þegar ófriður vofir yfir, veitir fjandmönnum íslenska ríkisins liðsinni í orði eða verki eða veikir viðnámsþrótt íslenska ríkisins eða bandamanna þess.
translated_text:
gr. 89. gr

If an Icelandic citizen bears arms in wartime against the Icelandic state or its allies, this shall be punishable by imprisonment for not less than 2 years.

The same penalty shall be imposed on anyone who, in wartime, or when war is imminent, provides assistance in word or deed to enemies of the Icelandic state or weakens the resistance capacity of the Icelandic state or its allies.

heading: 90. gr

Hafi manni orðið slíkt á af stórfelldu gáleysi, skal honum refsað með sektum eða [fangelsi allt að 1 ári]. 1)

1) L. 82/1998, 22.
translated_text:
90. gr

If a person, during wartime or when it is imminent, breaches a contract or obligation relating to measures that the Icelandic state has taken due to war or the threat of war, he shall be subject to … 1) imprisonment for up to 3 years.

If such an act has resulted from gross negligence, he shall be punished by fines or [imprisonment for up to 1 year]. 1)

1) L. 82/1998, 22.

heading: gr. 91. gr

text:
gr. 91. gr

Hver, sem kunngerir, skýrir frá eða lætur á annan hátt uppi við óviðkomandi menn leynilega samninga, ráðagerðir eða ályktanir ríkisins um málefni, sem heill þess eða réttindi gagnvart öðrum ríkjum eru undir komin,

eða hafa mikilvæga fjárhagsþýðingu eða viðskipta fyrir íslensku þjóðina gagnvart útlöndum, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 16 árum.

Sömu refsingu skal hver sá sæta, sem falsar, ónýtir eða kemur undan skjali eða öðrum munum, sem heill ríkisins eða réttindi gagnvart öðrum ríkjum eru undir komin.

Sömu refsingu skal enn fremur hver sá sæta, sem falið hefur verið á hendur af íslenska ríkinu að semja eða gera út um eitthvað við annað ríki, ef hann ber fyrir borð hag íslenska ríkisins í þeim erindrekstri.

Hafi verknaður sá, sem í 1. og 2. mgr. hér á undan getur, verið framinn af gáleysi, skal refsað með … ¹) fangelsi allt að 3 árum, eða sektum, ef sérstakar málsbætur eru fyrir hendi.

translated_text:
gr. 91. gr

Anyone who announces, reports or otherwise discloses to unauthorized persons secret agreements, plans or resolutions of the state concerning matters on which its security or rights vis-à-vis other states depend,

or which have significant financial or commercial importance for the Icelandic nation in relation to foreign countries, shall be subject to imprisonment for up to 16 years.

The same penalty shall be imposed on anyone who falsifies, destroys or conceals a document or other objects on which the security of the state or rights vis-à-vis other states depend.

The same penalty shall furthermore be imposed on anyone who has been entrusted by the Icelandic state to negotiate or conclude something with another state, if he betrays the interests of the Icelandic state in that mission.

If the act referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 above has been committed through negligence, it shall be punished by … ¹) imprisonment for up to 3 years, or fines if special mitigating circumstances exist.

¹) L. 82/1998, 23.

The same penalty shall be imposed on anyone who intentionally or negligently endangers the neutral status of the Icelandic state, assists a foreign state in violating its neutrality, or violates a prohibition that the state has imposed to protect its neutrality.

¹) L. 82/1998, 24.

kafli. Brot gegn stjórnskipan ríkisins og æðstu stjórnvöldum þess.

98. гр.

Veki maður eða stýri uppreisn í þeim tilgangi að breyta stjórnskipun ríkisins, þá varðar það fangelsi, ekki skemur en 3 ár eða ævilangt.

Hver, sem tekur þátt í þess konar uppreisn, svo og hver sá, sem sekur gerist um verknað, er miðar að því að breyta stjórnskipuninni á ólögmætan hátt, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 8 árum.

translated_text:
gr. XI

kafli. Offenses against the constitution of the state and its supreme authorities.

98. гр.

If a person instigates or leads a rebellion with the purpose of changing the constitution of the state, this shall be punishable by imprisonment for not less than 3 years or for life.

Anyone who participates in such a rebellion, as well as anyone who is guilty of an act aimed at changing the constitution by unlawful means, shall be subject to imprisonment for up to 8 years.

99. гр.

If a person undertakes anything aimed at depriving [the President] ¹) or the person exercising [presidential power] ¹) of life, this shall be punishable by imprisonment for not less than 6 years.

kafli. Brot gegn valdstjórninni.

106. гр.

[Ef brot samkvæmt þessari málsgrein beinist að opinberum starfsmanni, sem að lögum hefur heimild til líkamlegrar valdbeitingar, má beita fangelsi allt að 8 árum.] 2) [Beita má sektum, ef brot er smáfellt.] 3) [Sá sem tálmar því á annan hátt að handhafi lögregluvalds eða tollgæsluvalds gegni skyldustörfum sínum skal sæta sektum eða fangelsi allt að 2 árum. text:
118. gr

Ef maður kemur af stað upphlaupi í því skyni að beita menn eða muni ofbeldi eða ógna með, að því verði beitt, þá varðar það fangelsi allt að 3 árum … ¹)

Sömu refsingu skulu þeir menn sæta, sem gerst hafa leiðtogar slíks upphlaups, eftir að það var byrjað.

Aðrir þátttakendur upphlaupsins, sem ofríki hafa haft í frammi eða ekki hafa hlýðnast skipan yfirvalds, er skorað hefur á mannsöfnuðinn að sundrast, skulu sæta vægari refsingu að tiltölu, og má dæma þeim þátttakendum sektir, sem ekki hafa beitt ofríki.

Hafi eitthvert það brot verið framið, sem var markmið upphlaupsins, skal beita þyngri refsingum, miðað við þátttöku hvers eins, eftir því, sem að framan segir, og má þá dæma allt að 6 ára fangelsi, nema broti sé svo varið, að þyngri hegning liggi við.

¹) L. 82/1998, 40.
translated_text:
Art. 118

If a person instigates a riot with the purpose of using or threatening to use violence against persons or property, this shall be punishable by imprisonment for up to 3 years … ¹)

The same punishment shall be imposed on those who have become leaders of such a riot after it has begun.

Other participants in the riot who have committed violence or have not obeyed the order of an authority that has called upon the crowd to disperse shall be subject to proportionally lighter punishment, and fines may be imposed on those participants who have not used violence.

If any of the offences that were the objective of the riot have been committed, heavier punishments shall be imposed, based on the participation of each individual, according to what is stated above, and imprisonment of up to 6 years may then be imposed, unless the offence carries a heavier penalty.

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 40.

heading: Art. 119
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 119. гр

Hafi upphlaup átt sér stað, án þess að ákvæði 118. gr. eigi við um það, og mannsöfnuðinum hefur verið skipað á löglegan hátt af yfirvaldi að sundrast, þá skal þeim þátttakendum, sem hlýðnast ekki skipuninni, enda þótt þeir viti um hana, refsað með sektum eða [fangelsi] ¹) allt að 3 mánuðum.

¹) L. 82/1998, 41.
translated_text:
Art. 119

If a riot has taken place without the provisions of Art. 118 applying to it, and the crowd has been lawfully ordered by an authority to disperse, then those participants who do not obey the order, even though they know about it, shall be punished with fines or [imprisonment] ¹) for up to 3 months.

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 41.

heading: Art. 120
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 120. гр

Ef maður gabbar lögreglumenn, brunalíð, björgunarlið eða annað hjálparlið, með því að kalla eftir hjálp að ástæðulausu eða með misnotkun brunaboða eða annarra hættumerkja, þá varðar það sektum eða [fangelsi] ¹) allt að 3 mánuðum.

¹) L. 82/1998, 42. gr.

[120. гр. а.

[Nú veitir maður vísvitandi rangar upplýsingar eða lætur uppi vísvitandi rangar tilkynningar, sem eru fallnar til að vekja ótta um líf, heilbrigði eða velferð manna, um atriði sem varða loftferðaöryggi eða öryggi í flughöfn varðar það sektum … ¹) eða fangelsi allt að þremur árum. Sömu refsingu varðar að útbreiða þess háttar orðröm gegn betri vitund.] ²) ³)

¹) L. 82/1998, 43. gr. ²) L. 16/1990, 2. gr. ³) L. 41/1973, 2.
translated_text:
Art. 120

If a person deceives police officers, fire brigades, rescue teams or other emergency services by calling for help without cause or by misusing fire alarms or other danger signals, this shall be punishable by fines or [imprisonment] ¹) for up to 3 months.

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 42.

[Art. 120 a.

[If a person knowingly provides false information or knowingly makes false reports that are likely to cause fear for the life, health or welfare of persons, concerning matters relating to aviation safety or safety at an airport, this shall be punishable by fines … ¹) or imprisonment for up to three years. The same punishment applies to spreading such rumours against better knowledge.] ²) ³)

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 43. ²) Act 16/1990, Art. 2. ³) Act 41/1973, Art. 2.

heading: Art. 121
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 121. гр

Hver, sem opinberlega hvetur menn til refsiverðra verka, skal sæta … ¹) fangelsi allt að 2 árum, eða sektum, ef málsbætur eru, nema brot hans varði þyngri refsingu að lögum.

Hver, sem opinberlega og greinilega fellst á eitthvert þeirra brota, er í X. eða XI. kafla laga þessara getur, sæti sektum … ¹) eða fangelsi allt að 1 ári.

¹) L. 82/1998, 44.
translated_text:
Art. 121

Anyone who publicly incites persons to commit punishable acts shall be subject to … ¹) imprisonment for up to 2 years, or fines if there are mitigating circumstances, unless his offence carries a heavier punishment by law.

Anyone who publicly and clearly approves of any of the offences mentioned in Chapters X or XI of this Act shall be subject to fines … ¹) or imprisonment for up to 1 year.

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 44.

heading: Art. 122
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 122. гр

Hver, sem hindrar það, að löglegur mannfundur sé haldinn, skal sæta sektum eða [fangelsi allt að 1 ári], ¹) eða fangelsi allt að 2 árum, ef miklar sakir eru, einkum ef ofríki eða ógnun í framferði hefur verið viðhaft.

Raski nokkur fundarfriði á lögboðnum samkomum um opinber málefni með háreysti eða uppivöðslu, þá varðar það sektum eða [fangelsi] ¹) allt að 3 mánuðum.

Sömu refsingu skal sá sæta, sem á sama hátt truflar opinbera guðsþjónustu eða aðrar kirkjuathafnir eða raskar útfararhelgi.

¹) L. 82/1998, 45.
translated_text:
Art. 122

Anyone who prevents a lawful public meeting from being held shall be subject to fines or [imprisonment for up to 1 year], ¹) or imprisonment for up to 2 years if the circumstances are serious, especially if violence or threats have been used.

If anyone disturbs the peace of a meeting at lawful assemblies concerning public affairs by making noise or incitement, this shall be punishable by fines or [imprisonment] ¹) for up to 3 months.

The same punishment shall be imposed on anyone who in the same manner disturbs public worship or other church ceremonies or disturbs the sanctity of a funeral.

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 45.

heading: Art. 123
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 123. гр

Hver, sem af ásettu ráði eða stórfelldu gáleysi gerist ölvaður og stofnar þannig á sig kominn í hættu öðrum mönnum eða talsverðum fjárverðmætum, skal sæta sektum … ¹) eða fangelsi allt að 6 mánuðum, einkum ef brot er ítrekað eða miklar sakir að öðru leyti.

… ²)

¹) L. 82/1998, 46. gr. ²) L. 101/1976, 1.
translated_text:
Art. 123

Anyone who intentionally or through gross negligence becomes intoxicated and thereby poses a danger to other persons or considerable property values shall be subject to fines … ¹) or imprisonment for up to 6 months, especially if the offence is repeated or the circumstances are otherwise serious.

… ²)

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 46. ²) Act 101/1976, Art. 1.

heading: Art. 124
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 124. гр

Ef nokkur raskar grafarhelgi eða gerist sekur um ósæmilega meðferð á líki, þá varðar það sektum … ¹) eða fangelsi allt að 6 mánuðum.

Sömu refsingu varðar það að fara ósæmilega með hluti, sem teljast til kirkna og nota á við kirkjulegar athafnir.

¹) L. 82/1998, 47.
translated_text:
Art. 124

If anyone violates the sanctity of a grave or is guilty of indecent treatment of a corpse, this shall be punishable by fines … ¹) or imprisonment for up to 6 months.

The same punishment applies to indecent treatment of objects belonging to churches and used in church ceremonies.

¹) Act 82/1998, Art. 47.

heading: Art. 125
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time

heading: Art. 126
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 126. gr

Hafi maður fengið vitneskju um, að fyrirhugað er eða hafið eitthvert þeirra brota, sem 86., 87., 89., 91., 98., 99. eða 100. gr. laga þessara getur, eða annað brot, sem lífi eða velferð manna eða mikilvægum þjóðfélagsverðmætum er búin hætta af, og hann reynir ekki af fremsta megni að koma í veg fyrir brotið eða afleiðingar þess, þar á meðal, ef þörf krefur, með því að tilkynna yfirvöldum vitneskju sína, þá skal hann, ef brotið er eftir það framið eða reynt er að fremja það, sæta … 1) fangelsi allt að 3 árum, eða sektum, ef miklar málsbætur eru fyrir hendi. En hafi hann látið þetta hjá líða sökum þess, að hann gat ekki gert það án þess að stofna lífi, heilbrigði eða velferð sjálfs sín eða nánustu vandamanna í hættu, þá skal honum ekki refsað.

1) L. 82/1998, 49.
translated_text:
Art. 126

If a person has obtained knowledge that any of the offences mentioned in Arts. 86, 87, 89, 91, 98, 99 or 100 of this Act is planned or has been initiated, or another offence that poses a danger to the life or welfare of persons or important social values, and he does not try to the best of his ability to prevent the offence or its consequences, including, if necessary, by notifying the authorities of his knowledge, then he shall, if the offence is subsequently committed or an attempt is made to commit it, be subject to … 1) imprisonment for up to 3 years, or fines if there are considerable mitigating circumstances. But if he has omitted this because he could not do so without endangering the life, health or welfare of himself or his closest relatives, then he shall not be punished.

1) Act 82/1998, Art. 49.

heading: Art. 127
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 127. гр

Hver, sem ekki sinnir kvaðningu yfirvalds um aðstoð til þess að koma í veg fyrir brot eða annan ófarnað, sem lífi, heilbrigði eða velferð manna er búin hætta af, þótt hann hefði getað veitt aðstoðina án þess að stofna sér eða verulegum hagsmunum í hættu, skal sæta sektum eða [fangelsi] 1) allt að 3 mánuðum.

1) L. 82/1998, 50.
translated_text:
Art. 127

Anyone who does not comply with a summons from an authority for assistance in preventing an offence or other danger that poses a risk to the life, health or welfare of persons, even though he could have provided the assistance without endangering himself or substantial interests, shall be subject to fines or [imprisonment] 1) for up to 3 months.

1) Act 82/1998, Art. 50.

heading: XIV. Chapter. Offences in public office.
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
XIV. Chapter. Offences in public office.

Art. 128

If a public official, [member of parliament or arbitrator] 1) demands, accepts or allows to be promised to himself or others gifts or other benefits to which he is not entitled, in connection with the performance of his duties, then he shall be subject to … 2) imprisonment for up to 6 years, or fines if there are mitigating circumstances.

[The same punishment shall be imposed on a foreign public official, foreign juror, foreign arbitrator, a person who holds a seat in a foreign representative assembly exercising administrative functions, an employee of an international organization, a person who holds a seat in an assembly of such an organization or in a public legislative assembly in a foreign state, a judge who holds a seat in an international court or an employee of such a court, who demands, accepts or allows to be promised to himself or others gifts or other benefits to which he is not entitled, in connection with the performance of his duties.] 1)

1) Act 5/2013, Art. 5. 2) Act 82/1998, Art. 51.

heading: Art. 129
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 129. гр

Ef opinber starfsmaður heimtar eða tekur sér eða öðrum til ávinnings við sköttum eða gjöldum, [þar á meðal þjónustugjöldum], 1) sem gjaldandi skuldar ekki, þá varðar það fangelsi allt að 6 árum, enda liggi ekki þyngri refsing við verknaðinum eftir öðrum ákvæðum laganna. Vegari refsingu að tiltölu skal beita, ef sökunautur hefur í upphafi tekið við gjaldinu í þeirri trú, að gjaldandinn skuldaði það, en heldur gjaldinu síðan í ávinningsskyni, eftir að hann komst að hinu rétta. … 2)

1) L. 54/2003, 1.
translated_text:
Art. 129

If a public official demands or takes for himself or others profit from taxes or charges, [including service fees], 1) which the payer does not owe, this shall be punishable by imprisonment for up to 6 years, provided that a heavier punishment does not apply to the act under other provisions of the law. A lighter punishment shall be imposed proportionally if the offender initially accepted the payment in the belief that the payer owed it, but then keeps the payment for profit after he discovered the truth. … 2)

1) Act 54/2003, Art. 1. 2) Act 82/1998, Art. 52.

heading: Art. 130
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 130. гр

Ef handhafi dómsvalds eða annars opinbers úrskurðarvalds um lögskipti gerist sekur um ranglæti við úrlausn máls eða meðferð þess í því skyni, að niðurstaðan verði ranglát, þá skal hann sæta fangelsi allt að 6 árum. Hafi verknaðurinn haft eða verið ætlað að hafa í för með sér velferðarmissi fyrir nokkurn mann, þá skal refsingin vera fangelsi ekki skemur en 2 ár og allt að 16 árum.

131. гр.

Ef dómari eða annar opinber starfsmaður, sem á að halda uppi refsivaldi ríkisins, beitir ólöglegri aðferð til þess að koma manni til játningar eða sagna, framkvæmir ólöglega handtöku, fangelsan eða [leit] 1) eða leggur að ólögum hald á skjöl eða aðra muni, þá varðar það sektum … 2) eða fangelsi allt að 3 árum.

1) L. 54/2003, 2.
translated_text:
Art. 130

If a holder of judicial power or other public decision-making power concerning legal transactions is guilty of injustice in the resolution of a case or its handling with the purpose that the outcome will be unjust, then he shall be subject to imprisonment for up to 6 years. If the act has caused or was intended to cause loss of welfare for any person, then the punishment shall be imprisonment of not less than 2 years and up to 16 years.

heading: Art. 131
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
Art. 131

If a judge or other public official who is to uphold the penal power of the state uses an unlawful method to obtain a confession or testimony from a person, carries out an unlawful arrest, imprisonment or [search] 1) or unlawfully seizes documents or other objects, this shall be punishable by fines … 2) or imprisonment for up to 3 years.

1) Act 54/2003, Art. 2. 2) Act 82/1998, Art. 53.

heading: Art. 132
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 132. гр

[Ef opinber starfsmaður, sem í 130. gr. eða 131. gr. getur, gætir ekki af ásetningi eða stórfelldu gáleysi lögmætra aðferða við meðferð máls eða úrlausn, handtöku, hald, leit, fangelsan eða framkvæmd refsingar, eða við beitingu annarra áþekkra úrræða, þá skal hann sæta sektum eða fangelsi allt að 1 ári, nema brot hans varði þyngri refsingu að lögum.] 1)

1) L. 54/2003, 3.
translated_text:
Art. 132

[If a public official mentioned in Art. 130 or Art. 131 does not intentionally or through gross negligence observe lawful procedures in the handling or resolution of a case, arrest, seizure, search, imprisonment or execution of punishment, or in the application of other similar measures, then he shall be subject to fines or imprisonment for up to 1 year, unless his offence carries a heavier punishment by law.] 1)

1) Act 54/2003, Art. 3.

heading: Art. 133
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 133. гр

[Ef opinber starfsmaður, sem á að gæta fanga, þ.m.t. sakbornings sem sviptur hefur verið frelsi sínu, eða annast framkvæmd refsidóma, lætur fanga eða sakborning komast undan, tálmar framkvæmd dóms, hlífir manni við að taka út hegningu eða kemur því til leiðar að refsing er framkvæmd með öðru og vægara móti en mælt er, þá

varðar það fangelsi allt að 3 árum, eða sektum, ef brot er smáfellt.] 1)

1) L. 54/2003, 4.
translated_text:
Art. 133

[If a public official who is to guard prisoners, including an accused person who has been deprived of his liberty, or is responsible for the execution of penal judgments, allows a prisoner or accused person to escape, obstructs the execution of a judgment, shields a person from serving a sentence or brings it about that a sentence is executed in a different and lighter manner than prescribed, this shall be punishable by imprisonment for up to 3 years, or fines if the offence is minor.] 1)

1) Act 54/2003, Art. 4.

heading: gr. 134. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 134. gr

Misnoti opinber starfsmaður stöðu sína til þess að neyða mann til að gera eitthvað, þola eitthvað eða láta eitthvað ógert, þá skal hann sæta … 1) fangelsi allt að 3 árum.

1) L. 82/1998, 56.
translated_text:
gr. 134. gr

If a public official abuses his position in order to compel a person to do something, endure something or refrain from doing something, he shall be subject to … 1) imprisonment for up to 3 years.

1) L. 82/1998, 56.

heading: gr. 135. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 135. gr

Ef opinber starfsmaður tekur þátt í embættis- eða sýslunarbroti annars opinbers starfsmanns, sem undir hann er gefinn, eða leitast við að koma honum til að fremja slíkt brot, þá skal hann sæta þeirri refsingu, sem við því broti liggur, en þó svo aukinni, að bætt sé við hana allt að helmingi hennar.
translated_text:
gr. 135. gr

If a public official participates in an official misconduct or administrative offence by another public official who is subordinate to him, or attempts to induce him to commit such an offence, he shall be subject to the punishment prescribed for that offence, but increased by up to one half.

heading: 136. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
136. gr

Opinber starfsmaður, sem segir frá nokkru, er leynt á að fara og hann hefur fengið vitneskju um í starfi sínu eða varðar embætti hans eða sýslan, skal sæta … 1) fangelsi allt að einu ári. Hafi hann gert það til þess að afla sér eða öðrum óréttmæts ávinnings, eða noti hann slíka vitneskju í því skyni, má beita fangelsi allt að 3 árum.

Sömu refsingu skal sá sæta, sem látið hefur af opinberu starfi og eftir það segir frá eða misnotar á ofangreindan hátt vitneskju, sem hann hafði fengið í stöðu sinni og leynt á að fara.

1) L. 82/1998, 57.
translated_text:
136. gr

A public official who discloses something that is to be kept confidential and of which he has gained knowledge in his work or which concerns his office or duties, shall be subject to … 1) imprisonment for up to one year. If he has done so in order to obtain unlawful gain for himself or others, or if he uses such knowledge for that purpose, imprisonment for up to 3 years may be imposed.

The same punishment shall be imposed on a person who has left public service and thereafter discloses or abuses in the aforementioned manner knowledge which he had obtained in his position and which is to be kept confidential.

1) L. 82/1998, 57.

heading: gr. 137. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 137. gr

Ef opinber starfsmaður, sem hefur [póst- eða fjarskiptaþjónustu] 1) á hendi, rífur heimildarlaust upp, ónýtir eða skýtur undan bréfum eða sendingum, sem afhent eru til flutnings með pósti, eða ónýtir, aflagar eða skýtur undan skeytum, sem veitt hefur verið viðtaka til fyrirgreiðslu, þá varðar það … 2) fangelsi allt að 3 árum. [Sama á við um starfsmann lögaðila sem fengið hefur opinbert leyfi til póstþjónustu eða til að annast fjarskipti á grundvelli slíks leyfis eða verktaka sem sinnir póst- eða fjarskiptaþjónustu á ábyrgð lögaðila.] 1)

1) L. 54/2003, 5.
translated_text:
gr. 137. gr

If a public official who has [postal or telecommunications services] 1) in his charge, without authorization tears open, destroys or conceals letters or consignments that have been delivered for carriage by post, or destroys, corrupts or conceals messages that have been received for transmission, this shall be punishable by … 2) imprisonment for up to 3 years. [The same applies to an employee of a legal entity that has received a public licence for postal services or to operate telecommunications on the basis of such a licence or a contractor who provides postal or telecommunications services under the responsibility of a legal entity.] 1)

1) L. 54/2003, 5.

heading: gr. 2)
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time

heading: gr. 138. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 138. gr

Nú hefur opinber starfsmaður gerst sekur um refsilagabrot með verknaði, sem telja verður misnotkun á stöðu hans, og við því broti er ekki lögð sérstök refsing sem broti í embætti eða sýslan, þá skal hann sæta þeirri refsingu, sem við því broti liggur, en þó svo aukinni, að bætt sé við hana allt að helmingi hennar.
translated_text:
gr. 138. gr

If a public official has become guilty of a criminal offence by an act which is to be considered an abuse of his position, and no special punishment is prescribed for that offence as an offence in office or duty, he shall be subject to the punishment prescribed for that offence, but increased by up to one half.

heading: 139. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
139. gr

Hafi opinber starfsmaður, í öðrum tilfellum en lýst er hér að framan, misnotað stöðu sína sér eða öðrum til ávinnings eða til þess að gera nokkuð það, sem hallar réttindum einstakra manna eða hins opinbera, þá varðar það sektum … 1) eða fangelsi allt að 2 árum.

1) L. 82/1998, 59.
translated_text:
139. gr

If a public official has, in cases other than those described above, abused his position for his own or others' gain or in order to do something that prejudices the rights of individuals or the public, this shall be punishable by fines … 1) or imprisonment for up to 2 years.

1) L. 82/1998, 59.

heading: gr. 140. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 140. gr

Opinber starfsmaður, sem synjar eða af ásettu ráði lætur farast fyrir að gera það, sem honum er boðið á löglegan hátt, sæti sektum eða [fangelsi allt að 1 ári]. 1)

1) L. 82/1998, 60.
translated_text:
gr. 140. gr

A public official who refuses or deliberately fails to do what he is lawfully ordered to do, shall be subject to fines or [imprisonment for up to 1 year]. 1)

1) L. 82/1998, 60.

heading: gr. 141. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
gr. 141. gr

Opinber starfsmaður, sem sekur gerist um stórfellda eða ítrekaða vanrækslu eða hirðuleysi í starfi sínu, skal sæta sektum eða [fangelsi allt að 1 ári]. 1)

1) L. 82/1998, 61. gr.

[141. gr. a.

Opinber starfsmaður skv. 128., 129., 134., 135., 138., 139., 140. og 141. gr. þessara laga telst sá sem vegna stöðu sinnar eða heimildar í lögum getur tekið eða haft áhrif á ákvarðanir um réttindi og skyldur einstaklinga eða lögaðila eða ráðstafað eða haft áhrif á ráðstöfun opinberra hagsmuna.] 1)

1) L. 54/2003, 6.
translated_text:
gr. 141. gr

A public official who becomes guilty of serious or repeated negligence or carelessness in his work, shall be subject to fines or [imprisonment for up to 1 year]. 1)

1) L. 82/1998, 61. gr.

[141. gr. a.

A public official pursuant to Articles 128, 129, 134, 135, 138, 139, 140 and 141 of this Act is considered to be a person who, by virtue of his position or authority in law, can make or influence decisions concerning the rights and obligations of individuals or legal entities or dispose of or influence the disposition of public interests.] 1)

heading: 142. gr

text:
12. gr. 143. gr

Ekki varðar það sökunaut í opinberu refsimáli refsingu, þó að hann skýri rangt frá málavöxtum. Þeim manni skal ekki heldur refsað, sem rangt hefur skýrt frá atvikum vegna þess að réttar upplýsingar um þau hefðu getað bakað honum refsiábyrgð í slíku máli, eða hann hafði ástæðu til að halda, að svo væri.

[Hafi maður borið rangt fyrir rétti eða stjórnvaldi, sem í 1. mgr. 142. gr. getur, um atriði, sem honum var óheimilt að skýra frá eða heimilt að neita að gefa skýrslu um, má færa hegningu niður og jafnvel láta hana falla niður, ef málsbætur eru.] 1)

1) L. 101/1976.
translated_text:
142. gr

[Anyone who gives false testimony about something before a court or authority that has the power to administer an oath, shall be subject to imprisonment for up to 4 years. If the testimony was given under oath, this shall be considered an aggravating circumstance.

If the testimony is false in matters that do not concern the matter being investigated, fines or [imprisonment for up to 1 year] 1) may be imposed. 2)

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 62. gr. 2)

text:
13. gr. 144. гр

Hafi maður af stórfelldu gáleysi gerst sekur um verknað, sem refsiverður væri eftir 142. gr. eða 2. mgr. 143. gr., ef um ásetningsverk hefði verið að ræða, þá varðar það sektum eða [fangelsi allt að 6 mánuðum]. 1)

63. gr. 145. гр

[Hafi maður, án þess að brot hans varði við ákvæði 142. gr., gefið opinberu stjórnvaldi ranga yfirlýsingu að viðlögðum drengskap eða á annan samsvarandi hátt, þar sem slík aðferð er boðin eða heimiluð, þá varðar það sektum eða [fangelsi allt að 1 ári], 1) en fangelsi allt að 2 árum, ef sök er stórfelld.] 2)

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
12. gr. 143. gr

It is not punishable for a defendant in a public criminal case to give false testimony about the facts of the case. Nor shall a person be punished who has given false testimony about circumstances because correct information about them could have exposed him to criminal liability in such a case, or he had reason to believe that this was the case.

[If a person has given false testimony before a court or authority as referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 142 about matters which he was prohibited from testifying about or entitled to refuse to give testimony about, the punishment may be reduced and even waived if there are mitigating circumstances.] 1)

1) L. 101/1976.

heading: 13. gr. 144. гр
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
13. gr. 144. гр

If a person has through gross negligence become guilty of an act which would be punishable under Article 142 or paragraph 2 of Article 143 if it had been an intentional act, this shall be punishable by fines or [imprisonment for up to 6 months]. 1)

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 63. gr. 145. гр
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
14. gr. 146. гр

Ef maður að öðru leyti gefur opinberu stjórnvaldi ranga yfirlýsingu um málefni, sem honum er skylt að gefa upplýsingar um, þá skal hann sæta sektum … 1) eða fangelsi allt að 4 mánuðum.

Ákvæði 1. mgr. 143. gr. koma hér til greina eftir því, sem við á.

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
63. gr. 145. гр

[If a person, without his offence falling under the provisions of Article 142, has given a public authority a false declaration under penalty of honour or in another comparable manner, where such a method is offered or authorized, this shall be punishable by fines or [imprisonment for up to 1 year], 1) but imprisonment for up to 2 years if the offence is serious.] 2)

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 64. gr. 2)
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
65. gr. 147. гр

Ef maður annars lætur uppi ranga skriflega yfirlýsingu eða gefur skriflegt vottorð um eitthvað, sem honum er ekki kunnugt um, og það er ætlað til notkunar í dómsmálum, öðrum málefnum, sem varða hið opinbera eða gerðardómsmálum, þá skal hann sæta sektum … 1) eða fangelsi allt að 4 mánuðum.

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 14. gr. 146. гр
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
66. gr. 148. гр

Hver, sem með rangri kæru, röngum framburði, rangfærslu eða undanskoti gagna, öflun falsgagna eða á annan hátt leitast við að koma því til leiðar, að saklaus maður verði sakaður um eða dæmdur fyrir refsiverðan verknað, skal sæta … 1) fangelsi allt að 10 árum. Við ákvörðun refsingar skal hafa hliðsjón af því, hversu þung hegning er lögð við broti því, sem sagt er eða gefið til kynna, að viðkomandi hafi drýgt. … 2) Hafi brot haft eða verið ætlað að hafa í för með sér velferðarmissi fyrir nokkurn mann, þá skal refsað með fangelsi ekki skemur en 2 ár og allt að 16 árum.

Ákveða má í dómi, eftir beiðni þess, sem fyrir óréttinum hefur orðið, að niðurstaða dóms og það af forsendum hans, sem dómur telur hæfilegt, skuli birt að opinberri tilhlutan í einu eða fleirum opinberum blöðum eða ritum.

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
14. gr. 146. гр

If a person otherwise gives a public authority a false declaration about matters which he is obliged to provide information about, he shall be subject to fines … 1) or imprisonment for up to 4 months.

The provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 143 apply here as appropriate.

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 65. gr. 147. гр
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
65. gr. 147. гр

If a person otherwise makes a false written declaration or gives a written certificate about something of which he has no knowledge, and it is intended for use in court proceedings, other matters concerning the public or arbitration proceedings, he shall be subject to fines … 1) or imprisonment for up to 4 months.

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 66. gr. 148. гр
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
15. gr. 149. гр

Hver, sem gerist sekur um rangan uppljóstur til yfirvalds um að refsiverður verknaður hafi verið framinn, svo og hver sá, sem ber fram rangar kærur við [forsetann], 1) Alþingi, dómstóla eða yfirvald, skal sæta sektum eða [fangelsi allt að 1 ári]. 2)

1) L. 100/1951.
translated_text:
66. gr. 148. гр

Anyone who, by false accusation, false testimony, falsification or concealment of evidence, procurement of false evidence or in any other way, attempts to bring about that an innocent person is accused of or convicted of a punishable act, shall be subject to … 1) imprisonment for up to 10 years. In determining the punishment, consideration shall be given to the severity of the punishment prescribed for the offence which is alleged or suggested that the person concerned has committed. … 2) If the offence has caused or was intended to cause loss of welfare to any person, the punishment shall be imprisonment for not less than 2 years and up to 16 years.

It may be determined in a judgment, at the request of the person who has suffered the injustice, that the conclusion of the judgment and such parts of its reasoning as the court deems appropriate shall be published at public expense in one or more public newspapers or publications.

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 15. gr. 149. гр
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
68. gr. XVI

kafli. Peningafals og önnur brot, er varða gjaldmiðil.

150. гр.

Hver, sem falsar peninga í því skyni að koma þeim í umferð sem ósviknum gjaldeyri, svo og hver sá, sem í sama skyni aflar sér eða öðrum falsaðra peninga, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 12 árum.

Sé fölsun framkvæmd á þann hátt, að skert er efnisverð gjaldgengrar myntar, skal refsingin vera fangelsi allt að 4 árum.

151. гр.

Hver, sem lætur úti peninga, sem hann veit að eru falsaðir, skal sæta sömu refsingu sem hefði hann sjálfur falsað þá. Hafi hann haldið, að peningarnir væru ósviknir, þegar hann fékk þá, má beita [fangelsi allt að 1 ári] 1) eða

sektum.

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
15. gr. 149. гр

Anyone who becomes guilty of false reporting to an authority that a punishable act has been committed, as well as anyone who makes false complaints to [the President], 1) the Althingi, courts or an authority, shall be subject to fines or [imprisonment for up to 1 year]. 2)

1) L. 100/1951.

heading: 4. gr. 2)
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
69. gr. 152. gr

Hver, sem lætur úti peninga, sem hann hefur grun um að séu falsaðir, skal sæta … 1) fangelsi allt að 2 árum. Hafi hann haldið, að peningarnir væru ósviknir, þegar hann fékk þá, má beita sektum, og jafnvel, ef málsbætur eru, láta refsingu falla niður.

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 68. gr. XVI
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
70. gr. 153. gr

Það varðar sektum að búa til, flytja inn eða dreifa út meðal manna hlutum, sem að gerð og frágangi líkjast mjög peningum eða verðbréfum, sem ætluð eru til þess að ganga manna á milli.
translated_text:
68. gr. XVI

kafli. Peningafals og önnur brot, er varða gjaldmiðil.

150. гр.

Anyone who counterfeits money with the intention of putting it into circulation as genuine currency, as well as anyone who for the same purpose procures counterfeit money for himself or others, shall be subject to imprisonment for up to 12 years.

If the counterfeiting is carried out in such a way that the material value of legal tender is reduced, the punishment shall be imprisonment for up to 4 years.

151. гр.

Anyone who puts into circulation money which he knows to be counterfeit, shall be subject to the same punishment as if he had counterfeited it himself. If he believed the money to be genuine when he received it, [imprisonment for up to 1 year] 1) or

fines may be imposed.

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 69. gr. 152. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
154. gr

Sektum eða [fangelsi] 1) allt að 3 mánuðum skal sá sæta, sem án heimildar í lögum býr til, flytur inn eða lætur úti handhafabréf, sem notuð kunna að verða til þess að ganga sem gjaldmiðill manna á milli, hvort heldur almennt eða innan sérstaks flokks manna, eða vænta má, að notuð verði á þann hátt. Ákvæði þessarar greinar taka ekki til erlendra peningaseðla.

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
69. gr. 152. gr

Anyone who puts into circulation money which he suspects to be counterfeit, shall be subject to … 1) imprisonment for up to 2 years. If he believed the money to be genuine when he received it, fines may be imposed, and even, if there are mitigating circumstances, the punishment may be waived.

1) L. 82/1998.

translated_text:
70. gr. 153. gr

It is punishable by fines to manufacture, import or distribute among people objects which in design and finish closely resemble money or securities that are intended to pass from person to person.

heading: 154. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
155. gr

Hver, sem notar falsað skjal til þess að blekkja með því í lögskiptum, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 8 árum. Skal það einkum metið refsingu til þyngingar, ef skjalið er notað sem opinbert skjal, viðskiptabréf eða erfðaskrá.

[Sömu refsingu varðar að nota fölsuð gögn, sem geymd eru á tölvutæku formi, til að blekkja með þeim í lögskiptum.] 1)

Hafi aðeins verið um lítilræði að tefla, eða miklar málsbætur eru að öðru leyti, einkum ef fremjandi hefur ekki ætlað að baka öðrum tjón, má beita [fangelsi allt að 1 ári] 2) eða sektum.

1) L. 30/1998.
translated_text:
154. gr

Fines or [imprisonment] 1) up to 3 months shall be imposed on anyone who, without legal authorization, produces, imports or issues bearer instruments that could be used to circulate as currency between persons, whether generally or within a particular group of persons, or that may be expected to be used in that manner. The provisions of this article do not apply to foreign banknotes.

1) Act 82/1998.

heading: 71. gr. XVII
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
71. gr. XVII

Chapter. Forgery of documents and other offenses concerning tangible evidence.

heading: 155. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
72. gr. 156. gr

Sömu refsingu, sem í 155. gr. getur, skal sá sæta, sem notar skjal með ófalsaðri undirritun, til þess að blekkja með því í lögskiptum, enda hafi útgefandi þess verið gabbaður til að undirrita skjalið í þeirri trú, að það væri annað skjal eða skjal með öðru efni.
translated_text:
155. gr

Anyone who uses a forged document to deceive in legal transactions shall be subject to imprisonment up to 8 years. It shall be considered an aggravating circumstance if the document is used as a public document, commercial instrument or will.

[The same penalty applies to using forged data stored in computer-readable form to deceive in legal transactions.] 1)

If only a trivial matter was at stake, or there are significant mitigating circumstances otherwise, especially if the perpetrator did not intend to cause loss to others, [imprisonment up to 1 year] 2) or fines may be imposed.

1) Act 30/1998.

heading: 1. gr. 2)
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
157. gr

Noti maður ófalsað skjal svo sem það varðaði annan mann en þann, sem það á við, eða með öðrum hætti gagnstætt því, sem til var ætlast, og þetta er gert til þess að blekkja með því í lögskiptum, þá varðar það sektum … 1) eða fangelsi allt að 6 mánuðum.

[Ákvæði 1. mgr. eiga einnig við um notkun ófalsaðra gagna sem geymd eru á tölvutæku formi.] 2)

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 72. gr. 156. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
72. gr. 156. gr

The same penalty as provided in Article 155 shall be imposed on anyone who uses a document with a genuine signature to deceive in legal transactions, provided that the issuer was tricked into signing the document in the belief that it was another document or a document with different content.

heading: 157. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
2. gr. 158. gr

Ef maður tilgreinir eitthvað ranglega í opinberu skjali eða í bók eða í annars konar skjölum eða bókum, sem honum er skylt að gefa út eða rita, eða maður tilgreinir eitthvað ranglega í skjali eða bók, sem hann gefur út eða heldur í starfi, sem opinbera löggildingu þarf til að rækja, og það er gert til þess að blekkja með því í lögskiptum, þá varðar það … 1) fangelsi allt að 3 árum, eða sektum, ef málsbætur eru.

Sömu refsingu varðar það að nota þess háttar röng gögn í lögskiptum, sem væru þau rétt að efni til.

[Ákvæði 1. og 2. mgr. eiga einnig við um rangfærslu og notkun upplýsinga og gagna sem geymd eru á tölvutæku formi.] 2)

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
157. gr

If a person uses a genuine document as if it concerned another person than the one it pertains to, or in another manner contrary to what was intended, and this is done to deceive in legal transactions, it shall be punishable by fines … 1) or imprisonment up to 6 months.

[The provisions of paragraph 1 also apply to the use of genuine data stored in computer-readable form.] 2)

1) Act 82/1998.

heading: 73. gr. 2)
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time

heading: 2. gr. 158. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
3. gr. 159. gr

Nú hefur opinber stimpill eða merki, er sönnun skal veita fyrir því, að hlutur sé ósvikinn, eða fyrir uppruna hans, gæðum, tegund eða magni, verið sett á hlut án heimildar eða með fölsun, og skal þá sá, sem notar hlutinn til þess að blekkja aðra með honum í viðskiptum, sæta sektum … 1) eða fangelsi allt að 3 árum.

Sömu refsingu skal sá sæta, sem í sama skyni kemur því til leiðar með svikum, að þess háttar opinber stimpill eða merki sé sett á hluti, sem ekki eru til þess fallnir, eða notar slíka hluti.

Noti maður í sama skyni hluti, sem einkastimpill eða einkamerki hefur ranglega verið sett á, eða annað merki, sem á að segja til einhvers atriðis um hlutinn, sem máli skiptir í viðskiptum manna, þá varðar það sektum … 1)

eða fangelsi allt að 1 ári.

Refsingu eins og að ofan greinir skal ennfremur sá sæta, sem í því skyni að blekkja í viðskiptum notar hluti, eftir að stimpill, merki eða annað auðkenni, sem löglega hafði verið á hlutinn sett, hefur verið numið burtu eða rangfært.

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
2. gr. 158. gr

If a person falsely states something in a public document or in a book or in other kinds of documents or books that he is obliged to issue or write, or a person falsely states something in a document or book that he issues or maintains in a profession that requires official authorization to practice, and this is done to deceive in legal transactions, it shall be punishable by … 1) imprisonment up to 3 years, or fines if there are mitigating circumstances.

The same penalty applies to using such false data in legal transactions as if they were correct in content.

[The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 also apply to falsification and use of information and data stored in computer-readable form.] 2)

1) Act 82/1998.

heading: 74. gr. 2)
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
75. gr. 160. gr

Ef maður notar í atvinnuvegi sínum röng mælitæki eða vogaráhöld í því skyni að blekkja aðra í viðskiptum, þá varðar það fangelsi allt að 2 árum … 1). Sé sókin stórfelld, og eins ef manni verður slíkt á oftar, má þyngja hegningu allt að 6 ára fangelsi.

1) L. 82/1998.

heading: 3. gr. 159. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
76. gr. 161. gr

Hver, sem notar fölsuð póstfrímerki, stimpilmerki eða önnur slík merki, sem notuð eru sem sönnun fyrir greiðslu opinberra gjalda, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 8 árum. Lægri refsingu að tiltölu skal sá sæta, sem notar stimpilmerki eða frímerki, sem áður hefur verið notað, eftir að merkið um notkunina hefur verið numið burtu. Það varðar sektum að búa til, flytja inn eða dreifa út hlutum, sem að gerð og frágangi líkjast mjög stimpilmerkjum, póstfrímerkjum eða öðrum slíkum greiðslumerkjum.
translated_text:
3. gr. 159. gr

When an official stamp or mark, which is to provide proof that an item is genuine, or of its origin, quality, type or quantity, has been placed on an item without authorization or by forgery, anyone who uses the item to deceive others in commerce shall be subject to fines … 1) or imprisonment up to 3 years.

The same penalty shall be imposed on anyone who, for the same purpose, fraudulently causes such an official stamp or mark to be placed on items that are not suitable for it, or uses such items.

If a person uses, for the same purpose, items on which a private stamp or private mark has been falsely placed, or another mark intended to indicate some detail about the item that matters in commerce, it shall be punishable by fines … 1) or imprisonment up to 1 year.

A penalty as described above shall also be imposed on anyone who, for the purpose of deceiving in commerce, uses items after a stamp, mark or other identification that had been lawfully placed on the item has been removed or falsified.

1) Act 82/1998.

heading: 75. gr. 160. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
162. gr

Hver, sem rangfærir sönnunargögn eða kemur fram með röng sönnunargögn í því skyni að hafa áhrif á úrslit dómsmáls, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 2 árum. [Ef málsbætur eru og brot varðar ekki þyngri refsingu að lögum má beita sektum eða fangelsi allt að 1 ári.] 1)

Hver, sem til þess að halla eða fyrirgera rétti annarra, eyðileggur sönnunargagn, kemur því undan eða gerir það ónothæft að öllu eða einhverju leyti, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 2 árum … 1)

Nú hefur maður framið verknað þann, sem í 1. eða 2. mgr. getur, á gögnum, sem kynnu að hafa orðið af atriði um sekt hans í [sakamáli], 2) og er þá það verk refsilaust.

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
75. gr. 160. gr

If a person uses false measuring instruments or weighing devices in his trade for the purpose of deceiving others in commerce, it shall be punishable by imprisonment up to 2 years … 1). If the offense is extensive, and likewise if a person commits such an offense repeatedly, the penalty may be increased up to 6 years imprisonment.

1) Act 82/1998.

heading: 76. gr. 161. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
translated_text:
76. gr. 161. gr

Anyone who uses forged postage stamps, revenue stamps or other such marks used as proof of payment of public fees shall be subject to imprisonment up to 8 years. A lesser penalty proportionally shall be imposed on anyone who uses a revenue stamp or postage stamp that has been previously used, after the mark of use has been removed. It is punishable by fines to produce, import or distribute items that closely resemble revenue stamps, postage stamps or other such payment marks in design and finish.

heading: 162. gr
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
234. gr. 163. gr

Hver, sem í blekkingarskyni setur ranglega niður, flytur til, nemur á brott, rangfærir eða eyðileggur marksteina eða önnur merki, sem sýna skulu takmörk fasteignaréttinda, þar á meðal vatnsréttinda, skal sæta fangelsi allt að 3 árum …, 1) eða sektum, ef brot er smáfellt.

1) L. 82/1998.
translated_text:
162. gr

Anyone who falsifies evidence or presents false evidence for the purpose of influencing the outcome of a court case shall be subject to imprisonment up to 2 years. [If there are mitigating circumstances and the offense does not carry a heavier penalty by law, fines or imprisonment up to 1 year may be imposed.] 1)

Anyone who, in order to undermine or prejudice the rights of others, destroys evidence, conceals it or renders it unusable in whole or in part, shall be subject to imprisonment up to 2 years … 1)

When a person has committed an act referred to in paragraphs 1 or 2 on evidence that could have been relevant to his guilt in [a criminal case], 2) that act is not punishable.

1) Act 82/1998.

heading: 77. gr. 2)
heading_path: Select version Latest version at any time
text:
78. gr. XVIII

kafli. Brot, sem hafa í för með sér almannahættu.

heading: 234. gr. 163. gr

heading: Art. 194

text:
gr. 194. gr

[[Hver sem hefur samræði eða önnur kynferðismök við mann án samþykkis hans gerist sekur um nauðgun og skal sæta fangelsi ekki skemur en 1 ár og allt að 16 árum. Samþykki telst liggja fyrir ef það er tjáð af frjálsum vilja. Samþykki telst ekki liggja fyrir ef beitt er ofbeldi, hótunum eða annars konar ólögmætri nauðung. Til ofbeldis telst svipting sjálfræðis með innilokun, lyfjum eða öðrum sambærilegum hætti.] ¹)

Það telst einnig nauðgun og varðar sömu refsingu og mælt er fyrir um í 1. mgr. [að beita blekkingum eða notfæra sér villu viðkomandi um aðstæður eða] ¹) að notfæra sér geðsjúkdóm eða aðra andlega fötlun manns til þess að hafa við hann samræði eða önnur kynferðismök, eða þannig er ástatt um hann að öðru leyti að hann getur ekki spornað við verknaðinum eða skilið þýðingu hans.] ²)

¹) L. 16/2018, 1. gr. ²) L. 61/2007, 3.
translated_text:
Art. 194

[[Anyone who has sexual intercourse or other sexual contact with a person without his consent is guilty of rape and shall be subject to imprisonment of not less than 1 year and up to 16 years. Consent is deemed to exist if it is expressed of free will. Consent is not deemed to exist if violence, threats or other unlawful coercion is used. Violence includes deprivation of liberty by confinement, drugs or other similar means.] ¹)

It is also considered rape and is punishable by the same penalty as provided for in paragraph 1 [to use deception or exploit the person's error about circumstances or] ¹) to exploit a person's mental illness or other mental disability in order to have sexual intercourse or other sexual contact with him, or his condition is otherwise such that he cannot resist the act or understand its significance.] ²)

¹) Act 16/2018, Art. 1. ²) Act 61/2007, 3.

[199. gr. a.

Art. 199

[Anyone who is guilty of sexual harassment shall be subject to imprisonment for up to 2 years. Sexual harassment consists inter alia

[Art. 199 a

[Hver sem hefur samræði eða önnur kynferðismök við barn sitt eða annan niðja skal sæta fangelsi allt að [8 árum] ¹) og allt að [12 ára] ¹) fangelsi sé barnið [á aldrinum 15, 16 eða 17 ára]. ²)
